name: @leon-pixel/mcp-health
stderr:
Usage: mcp-health [options] [command]

Scan MCP server configs and report health, missing commands, and unpinned
packages

Options:
  -V, --version           output the version number
  -h, --help              display help for command

Commands:
  check [options] [root]  Scan a project (or paths) for MCP config issues
  help [command]          display help for command
